item.title: Wisconsin primary tests Democratic Party's direction
item.description: Candidates compete for the first open gubernatorial seat since 2010.

item.title: Zelenskyy reports North Korean missiles used by Russia in Ukraine
item.description: Russia and North Korea have cooperated in the offensive against Ukraine since 2024.

item.title: Video captures tractor trailer striking overpass
item.description: The top of the 18-wheeler was nearly sheared off in Rockland County, New York, causing the truck to overturn and land on its side.

item.title: Syrian court sentences former President Assad to death in absentia
item.description: A Syrian court has sentenced ousted President Bashar Assad and his younger brother to death in absentia for crimes against humanity and war crimes.
